plugins.name: AniLiberty
plugins.author: Mediary community
plugins.description: Russian dubs of anime from AniLiberty (aniliberty.top), formerly AniLibria: whole-season torrents through the site's public API.

plugins.name: MangaLib
plugins.author: Mediary community
plugins.description: Manga in Russian from MangaLib (mangalib.me), through the API its own site uses; every translation team of a chapter is a copy of its own.

plugins.name: SlashLib
plugins.author: Mediary community
plugins.description: Manga in Russian from SlashLib (slashlib.me), MangaLib's sister site for BL titles, through the API both use. Some titles are 18+.

plugins.name: MangaHub
plugins.author: Mediary community
plugins.description: Manga in Russian from MangaHub (mangahub.ru), read from its pages.

plugins.name: ZazaZa
plugins.author: Mediary community
plugins.description: Manga in Russian from ZazaZa (a.zazaza.me), of ReadManga's Grouple network, read from its pages. The site signs its images' addresses and its image server refuses them outside a browser; the plugin drops the signature, which works around the site's protection and may stop working.

plugins.name: Nyaa
plugins.author: Mediary community
plugins.description: Anime releases from Nyaa (nyaa.si), read from its search page.
